tool.name: Hopla 3
tool.description: genomic family analysis and legacy settings conversion
tool.command: #if str($operation.subcommand) == "run": #set $settings_path = 'settings.yaml' if $operation.settings.is_of_type('yaml') else 'settings.json' #set $vcf_path = 'input.vcf.gz' if $operation.vcf.is_of_type('vcf_bgzip') else 'input.vcf' ln -s '$operation.settings' '$settings_path' && ln -s '$operation.vcf' '$vcf_path' && #if $operation.vcf.is_of_type('vcf_bgzip'): ln -s '$operation.vcf.metadata.tabix_index' '${vcf_path}.tbi' && #end if hopla -L debug run -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} #if $operation.cytoband: -c '$operation.cytoband' #end if $operation.export_parquet $operation.export_bigwig '$settings_path' '$vcf_path' && mv *-output.html '$report' #if $operation.export_parquet or $operation.export_bigwig: && tar -czf '$exports' *-export #end if #else: hopla -L debug convert '$operation.legacy' '$converted_settings' #end if

param.name: cytoband
param.label: UCSC hg38 cytoband table
param.help: Path to a cytoband table on the job host; it must be readable from inside the job container. Clear the field to download the hg38 table from UCSC.

tool.help:
**Hopla**
**Run family analysis** analyzes a multisample family VCF from schema-validated YAML or JSON settings and writes a self-contained interactive HTML report, optionally with an archive of the Parquet or IGV exports.
A bgzip-compressed VCF is read per contig with all allocated job slots, using the tabix index Galaxy keeps for the dataset. An uncompressed VCF is scanned sequentially.
The cytoband table is read from the path in **UCSC hg38 cytoband table**, which must be readable from inside the job container. Clearing the field makes Hopla download the hg38 table from UCSC instead, which requires the job to have network access.
**Convert legacy settings** converts the historical ``key=value`` settings format to the YAML accepted by the analysis.
The report requires JavaScript. Galaxy administrators must add the ``hopla3`` tool id to the file configured by ``sanitize_allowlist_file`` so Galaxy serves the report without HTML sanitization.
